1difa64:303: Hermes is an autonomous AI agent runtime framework developed by Nous Research. It is not a single Q&A-style model wrapper, but an Agent Runtime that can run continuously, call tools, accumulate experience, and grow with usage. When an AI agent actually starts solving problems, whether it completes them correctly or goes off course, the truly difficult question is often not whether the result is right, but what it actually did. A single run of Hermes is not an ordinary model invocation. A seemingly simple interaction can involve multiple rounds of reasoning, tool calls, result feedback, context expansion, and new reasoning loops behind the scenes. If the system can only provide the final reply, a few scattered logs, or a usage summary of one invocation, Hermes remains a black box.
